parameters.content:
## Set the main Switch to On

- Move gripper to switch position
- Start goal with policy controller
- If success: continue
- Else: Retry

On Error: Set error value to display in form

Manual skip -> Enable Spacemouse again

## Set four switches to on position
- Operator selects from dropdown
- Move to target
- Policy action
- Move back to gripper base pos
- Operator selects again until done

## Three rotary switches
- Select from dropdown until done
- Try
